verdict.rationale: Attaching images to a task is a fair capability for a coding agent, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents attaching a screenshot, mockup or other image as task input. The browser automation and session-recording features (openhands-docs-21, openhands-docs-22) cover agent-side browsing and replay, not user-supplied visual specs, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can attach a marked-up screenshot or mockup to a task so the agent implements the correct visual change
